---
title: "Session 10: Towards Inclusive Societies: Global Challenges and Perspectives"
---

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}
### Guiding question
How can inclusive societies be developed in the context of global social, political, ecological and technological transformations?
:::

The final session brings the perspectives of the seminar together and asks how inclusive and just societies can be shaped under conditions of global transformation, and where the limits lie.

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .session-box}
#### Topics

- Preconditions of inclusive societies
- Empowerment and participation
- Inclusive governance and political participation
- Social resilience and cohesion
- Sustainable development and social justice
- The Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
- Possibilities and limits of international inclusion strategies
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .session-box}
#### Key theories and concepts

- Social Resilience
- Empowerment
- Inclusive Governance
- Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
:::
